risk_note: RV1 (H5 ledger page). Orchestrator D10-990 / D10-992 ②: the balance ledger page's pull-to-refresh truncated the cached infinite list to its first page before the request, so a failed refresh silently lost every later page. Following F1-04c's messages page fix, refresh now requests the first page once (GET /v1/wallet/ledger, no cursor); on success it replaces the cache with that single page, on failure it leaves all loaded pages untouched and shows the page's existing failure banner (existing text keys) with a one-shot retry; while a refresh is in flight load-more never runs with an old cursor, and a refresh asked for during load-more stays queued. Only ledger-page.tsx changed (+17 / -11); no contract, API or text-key change. Host: rule tests + frozen h5-ledger 33/33, h5 unit 13/13, tsc (couli-src) 0; full verification by the required CI checks. Round 2 (CI on #2796): the existing H5 unit test apps/h5/src/shared/api/logout-queued-refresh.test.tsx failed (expected 2 to be 1) because the hand-rolled first-page fetch bypassed react-query's account-generation binding, so a refresh queued during load-more still fetched a token and sent a request after logout. Fixed in ledger-page.tsx only (+21 / -3): the page and the ['wallet','ledger'] query must still be alive before a queued refresh runs, before a refresh starts, before writing the cache and before showing the failure banner; the existing test unchanged. Host: apps/h5 unit 92/92 (incl. logout-queued-refresh), rule + frozen h5-ledger 33/33, tsc 0. The verify-spec-2 / props-3 / props-sha-3 reds of the old head were the main-wide H5 bundle budget (D10-1001), fixed by #2795; this head is rebased onto it.
